note: These sources were investigated. No file from them is treated as downloaded transaction, entity, or survey microdata.

items.source: National Open Data Portal company register
items.result: TLS certificate chain is incomplete. The leaf is a valid Sectigo certificate for *.data.gov.tn, but the server presents an intermediate that does not sign that leaf. The request was not completed with certificate verification disabled.

items.source: Registre National des Entreprises public site
items.result: The public page is a web application shell. No company extract was downloaded. KYC and beneficial-owner access described by the registry requires an account or an agreement. That gate was not bypassed.
Catalog search records were saved. The 2024 Tunisia study is direct-download access. The microdata files themselves were not retrieved. Only World Bank indicator API aggregates were saved.

items.source: World Bank Enterprise Survey Tunisia 2024 microdata
items.result: The economy page returned an application shell without firm-level rows. Catalog id 6706 is remote access. Firm microdata was not downloaded.
www.smt.tn timed out, www.monetique.tn did not resolve, and www.smt.com.tn failed hostname verification. No Monétique file was saved. Payment totals used here are the BCT tables.
The catalog lists Taux de change with a data view and no Excel or SDMX download link. No exchange-rate file was saved. Monthly FX-market pages that were saved are turnover tables, not TND quotes.
